title: Odisha Police arrest three in New Delhi over fake trading platform fraud of ₹29.54 lakh against a Bhubaneswar retiree
date_note: The page gives no earlier day for the arrests; it is dated 25 November 2026. The fraud itself is described as starting in April 2026.
summary: According to police, quoted by The420.in, Odisha Police have arrested three men from New Delhi over a fake trading platform that cheated a retired private-sector employee from Bhubaneswar. The article says the additional payment increased his total reported loss to ₹29.54 lakh.
plain: Police say three men were arrested in New Delhi over a fake trading platform that cheated a retiree in Bhubaneswar; his reported loss is ₹29.54 lakh.
exec: Police quoted by The420.in say three men were arrested over a fake trading platform; the victim's reported loss is ₹29.54 lakh.
geo_basis: Victim is stated to be from Bhubaneswar; arrests were made in New Delhi

evidence.quote: The additional payment increased his total reported loss to ₹29.54 lakh.
Odisha Police have arrested three men from New Delhi

validation.note: Only The420.in read; it relays the police account. No police release was read.

review.note: 3 arrests in New Delhi, 29.54 lakh, retiree, date vs The420.in
